news.title: Draisaitl scores twice, McDavid has 3 assists to extend streak and Oilers beat skidding Canucks 4-2
news.ruTitle: Драйзайтль забил дважды, Макдэвид сделал 3 передачи и продлил серию, а «Ойлерз» обыграли «Кэнакс» со счетом 4–2.
news.description: — Leon Draisaitl had two goals and an assist, Connor McDavid added three more assists and the Edmonton Oilers beat the struggling Vancouver Canucks 4-2 on Saturday night.

news.title: Sidney Crosby takes sole possession of 6th on NHL scoring list in Penguins' 5-2 win over Kings
news.ruTitle: Сидни Кросби единолично занимает 6-е место в списке бомбардиров НХЛ в победе «Пингвинз» над «Кингз» со счетом 5:2.
news.description: — Sidney Crosby scored two goals while moving into sole possession of sixth place on the NHL’s career scoring list, and the Pittsburgh Penguins snapped their four-game skid with a 5-2 victory over the Los Angeles Kings on Saturday night.

news.title: Blackwood makes 27 saves, Necas has 4 points, Avs beat Wings 4-0
news.ruTitle: Блэквуд делает 27 сейвов, у Нечаса 4 очка, Авс обыграл Уингз со счетом 4-0.
news.description: — Mackenzie Blackwood made 27 saves, Martin Necas had two goals and two assists and the Colorado Avalanche beat the Detroit Red Wings 4-0 on Saturday night.

news.title: Nikita Kucherov scores power-play goal in overtime and Lightning rally for 4-3 win over Wild
news.ruTitle: Никита Кучеров забил гол в большинстве в овертайме и в розыгрыше «Лайтнинг» одержал победу над «Уайлдом» со счетом 4:3.
news.description: — Nikita Kucherov scored a power-play goal 3:23 into overtime and the Tampa Bay Lightning rallied past the Minnesota Wild 4-3 on Saturday night.

news.title: Harley has a goal and 2 assists to lead the Stars past the struggling Sharks, 4-3
news.ruTitle: Харли забил гол и сделал 2 результативные передачи, чтобы вывести "Старз" из борьбы с "Шаркс" со счетом 4-3.
news.description: — Defenseman Thomas Harley scored one of Dallas’ three power-play goals in his first three-point game of the season and the Stars beat the San Jose Sharks 4-3 on Saturday night.
